qc.pca_descriptive_outlier_rule: Flag if absolute PC1 or PC2 score exceeds 2 sample SD; no samples removed.

marker_score.label: Leukocyte marker-score proxy, not cell-fraction deconvolution

power.model: Two-sample independent t-test, equal group sizes, two-sided alpha=0.05, 80% power, df=6

interpretation_rule.supportive: At least 6/8 concordant AND composite AUC >= 0.80 AND empirical matched-null AUC P < 0.05
interpretation_rule.partially_supportive: 5/8 concordant OR AUC 0.65-0.80 with empirical matched-null AUC P >= 0.05
